segments.text: Openwork, the open-source alternative to claude co-work. It is a native desktop app that gives you that same agentic
experience for free running locally on your machine. Powered by the open code engine, it wraps the chaos of a terminal agent into a clean, beautiful guey. It
features a proper permission system so you know exactly when the AI is trying to delete a file and a visual dashboard to track its plans and progress.
